Chiefs of Ontario
IT Specialist – Economic Development

The Chiefs of Ontario is seeking an IT Specialist to support Economic Development programs.

Responsibilities:
- Develop Power BI data models using data modelling practices (DAX, Power Query, star schema design) and manage Power BI Service workspaces and refresh cycles.
- Build multi-source data pipelines from Excel datasets and ESRI ArcGIS visuals with geocoding.
- Support data governance, audit logging, and access controls for reporting systems.

Required Qualifications:
- Experience with Power BI Desktop, Power BI Service, DAX, Power Query, M-Files, document management, and OCAP.
- Knowledge of cybersecurity, audit logging, access controls, and systems administration.

Preferred Qualifications:
- SharePoint experience and strong stakeholder communication are assets.

Salary range: $80,000 to $95,000. We are an equal opportunity employer.
Apply through the COO careers portal. PM-V&C, plan B, C-suite technical support systems information related environment.
